integrity: The exact integer checker validates finite active-facet and incidence tables; the continuous parameter and nongeneric-direction arguments are supplied analytically, not inferred from numeric testing.
scientific_limitations: No claim of historical priority beyond accessible inspected sources; the 2012 paper already treats ordinary illumination of the regular rhombicuboctahedron. No statement for arbitrary 26-faced combinatorial realizations or for the singular limiting octahedron. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_scope: All real a>1 for the convex hull of signed coordinate permutations of (a,1,1); the cube endpoint a=1 is assessed separately; invertible affine images included.
title: Exact fractional illumination of expanded cubes and the rhombicuboctahedron
